blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.
blocks.zh: 结构层面的野火脆弱性评估对于减少野地-城市界面社区的损失至关重要,但现有方法往往未能将地块规模的点火路径同社区范围的地理覆盖结合起来。 本研究引入了Wildfire-SSR(Satellite and Street-view for Wirdfire Risk),这是一个地缘感-多模式框架,将宏观规模的卫星环境与微观规模的街景证据相融合. 一个Vision-Language Model从事前街景全景中提取出与野火相关的建筑和站点属性,并把它们转换成结构化的语义文本. 这些特征通过解接的相通聚变码器在空间上与卫星图像相配合,而被冷冻的卫星前置的DINOv3编码器则能捕捉起伏的视觉上下文. 评价其他地理定位嵌入战略,将文本生成的特征固定在每个卫星上。 该框架在洛杉矶受2025年伊通和帕利萨德斯大火影响的约37 000个结构上进行了测试,使用相对事件后破坏模式产生的野火风险标签来更好地代表固有的结构脆弱性。 旋转姿势 嵌入提供了最强的空间地平面,实现了建筑本地化F1分0.6735分,并实现了五等象素级风险分级的谐波平均分F1分0.2476分,性能优异的单式基线和无预设的多式配置. 该模型还显示在高风险类别中存在保守偏好,减少了重度风险低估,并在单个GPU上以37分钟完成对研究区的端到端评估. Wildfire-SSR将交叉视角聚变重新设定为局部语义结合,并为缓解优先排序、复原力规划和以保险为导向的野火风险评估提供了一个可扩展的工具。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Wildfire losses in wildland-urban interface (WUI) communities are shaped not only by the intensity of fire behavior at the landscape scale, but also by the ignition susceptibility of individual structures ( Calkin et al., 2014 ) . This makes structure-level vulnerability assessment a central problem for resilience planning, because mitigation decisions are implemented at the parcel and building level even when hazards unfold across regions. Yet the prevailing alternatives remain unsatisfactory: manual inspections provide rich detail but are too labor-intensive to scale, while automated overhead analyses can cover large areas but overlook the facade-level conditions that often determine whether a structure ignites. As wildfire exposure expands across complex urban-wildland settings, the ability to detect both community-scale exposure patterns and building-scale vulnerabilities becomes increasingly important. This paper therefore tackles a problem of high scientific and societal consequence: how to produce structure-specific wildfire intelligence without sacrificing geographic coverage.
blocks.zh: 野地-城市界面社区(WUI)的野生火灾损失不仅由地貌规模的火灾行为强度所决定,而且还由单个结构的点火易感所决定(Calkin等,2014年). 这使得结构层面的脆弱性评估成为复原力规划的核心问题,因为即使在灾害跨区域蔓延时,缓解决定也在整体和建筑层面得到落实。 然而,目前的替代办法仍然不能令人满意:人工检查提供了丰富的细节,但劳力过于密集,无法扩大规模,而自动化间接费用分析可以覆盖大片地区,但忽略往往决定结构是否起火的表面条件。 随着野火暴露在复杂的城市-荒地环境中扩大,发现社区规模的暴露模式和建筑物规模的脆弱性的能力变得越来越重要。 因此,本文件涉及一个具有高度科学和社会后果的问题:如何在不牺牲地理覆盖范围的情况下产生针对特定结构的野火情报。

blocks.en: Remote sensing has long served as the foundation for scalable disaster risk analytics ( Platt, 2014 ; Ahmed et al., 2018 ) , efficiently mapping macro-level features such as building footprints, canopy cover, and regional vegetation continuity ( Wu et al., 2025 ; Xiao and Mostafavi, 2025 ; Ho and Mostafavi, 2025 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Kaur et al., 2023 ) . However, top-down vantage points cannot capture the ground-level drivers of structure ignition such as combustible siding, unenclosed eaves, debris accumulation, or vegetation in direct contact with exterior walls ( Dossi et al., 2023 ; Papathoma-Köhle et al., 2022 ; Syphard et al., 2017 ) . Street-view imagery recovers these facade-level attributes ( Xia et al., 2025 ; Ho et al., 2024 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Esparza et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2026 ) . However, it lacks the landscape and terrain context that satellite basemaps provide, so a comprehensive assessment naturally requires integrating both modalities ( Esparza et al., 2025a ) .
blocks.zh: 遥感长期以来一直是可扩展灾害风险分析的基础(Platt,2014;Ahmed等,2018年),高效地绘制了建筑脚印,树冠覆盖等宏观层面特征,以及区域植被连续性(Wu等,2025;Xiao and Mostafavi,2025;Ho and Mostafavi,2025;Hu等,2024;Kaur等,2023年). 然而自上而下优势点无法捕捉出与外墙直接相接的地平面起火驱动力,如可燃斜拉索、未封闭的叶片、碎片堆积或植被(多西等,2023;帕帕托马-克勒等,2022;斯普哈德等,2017)。 街景图像可以恢复这些外表层属性 (Xia等,2025;Ho等,2024;Xia等,2025;Esparza等,2025b;Li等,2026.). 然而,它缺乏卫星基准图所提供的地貌和地形环境,因此,全面评估自然需要综合两种模式(Esparza等,2025a)。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Existing cross-view fusion paradigms assume a one-to-one mapping between a single satellite patch and a single street-view image ( Hu et al., 2018 ; Shi and Li, 2022 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) , which is architecturally and computationally inefficient at community scale. Because a high-resolution satellite image patch covers a broad geographic extent containing multiple structures, it must instead be paired with a corresponding batch of street-view images to accurately evaluate the entire scene. Processing a large overhead basemap alongside multiple high-resolution street-view images through a joint visual architecture rapidly exceeds practical computing resource limits. Instead, real-world success requires a deployment-centric approach that proactively aligns with practical constraints from the outset ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . Vision-Language Models (VLMs) offer a practical alternative by compressing high-resolution street-view imagery into lightweight structured text ( Xiao et al., 2025 ; Esparza et al., 2025b ) . These models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in the zero-shot and few-shot extraction of structured semantic information from complex structural and urban environments ( Ho et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2025 ; Kuckreja et al., 2024 ) . This approach preserves critical semantic attributes, such as roof material, defensible space, and debris presence, while drastically reducing the computational burden. Text-based compression resolves scalability, but introduces a distinct challenge of spatial alignment. Current methods rely on vision-based cross-view localization ( Hu et al., 2018 ; Shi and Li, 2022 ; Wang et al., 2021 ; Zhu et al., 2021 ) while underutilizing a readily available signal: satellite imagery is georeferenced and street-view captures carry precise coordinates.

blocks.en: To capture geographic context, researchers have increasingly explored explicit geolocation embedding methods that project raw coordinates into feature spaces. Early approaches relied on concatenating explicit geographic data with visual features ( Tang et al., 2015 ; Christie et al., 2018 ) . More recent studies have advanced beyond discrete metadata by learning continuous semantic embeddings directly from GPS coordinates ( Yin et al., 2019 ; Vivanco Cepeda et al., 2023 ) . This continuous modeling approach has also been adapted specifically for remote sensing foundation models ( Klemmer et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) . While these existing methods successfully and effectively bridge geospatial embeddings with dense visual architectures, they are fundamentally designed to learn global location embeddings suitable for broad, macro-level area studies with simplified one-to-one image-coordinate alignment. Assessing fine-grained, community-scale vulnerabilities instead requires a local, many-to-one architecture capable of spatially anchoring multiple street-level observations within a single high-resolution satellite basemap. The adaptable positional encodings developed for Vision Transformers (ViT), including fixed sinusoidal encodings ( Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , learnable absolute encodings ( Dosovitskiy et al., 2020 ) , relative encodings ( Liu et al., 2021 ) , Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) ( Su et al., 2024 ) , and Random Fourier Features (RFF) ( Tancik et al., 2020 ) , provide a principled mechanism to inject such fine-grained spatial awareness, but their use for geolocation-aware fusion of satellite imagery and multiple street-view texts remains largely unexplored.
blocks.zh: 为了了解地理背景,研究人员越来越多地探索明确的地理定位嵌入方法,将原始坐标投入地物空间。 早期方法依赖于整理具有视觉特征的明确的地理数据(Tang等人,2015年;Christie等人,2018年)。 最近的研究已经超越了离散元数据,直接从GPS坐标中学习连续语义嵌入(Yin等,2019;Vivanco Cepeda等,2023)。 这一连续的建模方法也被专门用于遥感基础模型(Klemmer等,2025;Liu等,2025b)。 虽然这些现有方法成功地有效地将地理空间嵌入与密集的视觉结构相接,但从根本上来说,这些方法旨在学习适合广泛宏观区域研究的全球位置嵌入,并简化一对一图像坐标相接。 评估精细的、社区规模的薄弱环节需要一种能够将多条街道观测点在空间上固定在单一高分辨率卫星基图内的局部多对一结构。 为Visual Transformers(ViT)所开发的可适应位置编码,包括固定的sinusoidal编码(Vaswani等,2017年),可学习的绝对编码(Dosovitskiy等,2020年),相对编码. (Liu等,2021年),"扶轮姿势嵌入"(ROPE等,2024年)和"随机花纹"(RFFF等,2020年),为注入这种精细的空间意识提供了一个原则性机制,但其用于对卫星图像和多条街景文本的地貌感知融合,至今基本上仍未被探索.

blocks.en: Taken together, existing wildfire vulnerability studies remain fragmented across scale and modality. Neither macro-scale remote sensing nor micro-scale street imagery is sufficient on its own, and naïve multimodal fusion does not scale. This paper departs from that literature by treating structure-level wildfire assessment as a many-to-one spatial alignment problem, addressing not only a data-fusion gap but a scalability gap that has limited the operational use of multimodal wildfire analytics. The rationale for the proposed design is that wildfire vulnerability is jointly produced by parcel-specific ignition conditions and surrounding environmental context, so the model must represent both. To this end, we propose a geolocation-aware multimodal framework for structure-level wildfire risk assessment. A VLM first extracts detailed building attributes from pre-event street-view imagery into structured text, while a satellite-pretrained DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) vision foundation model extracts macro-level features from the corresponding satellite patch. The framework then bridges the text-imagery spatial disconnect by mapping the latitude and longitude of each street-view capture to relative pixel coordinates within the satellite patch and injecting this signal into CLIP-encoded ( Radford et al., 2021 ) text features through three alternative strategies: RoPE ( Su et al., 2024 ) for relative dependencies, RFF ( Tancik et al., 2020 ) for absolute high-dimensional embeddings, and a Spatial Grid Mapping that places text features into a 2D spatial tensor at their grid coordinates. A cross-attention fusion decoder finally aligns these spatially aware text features with overhead visual features to produce structure-level vulnerability predictions. Figure 1 illustrates the proposed workflow.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,现有的野火脆弱性研究在规模和方式上仍然支离破碎。 无论是宏观规模的遥感还是微观规模的街道图像,都不足以单独实现,而"天真"的多模式聚变也不具有规模. 本文与文献不同,将结构层面的野火评估视为一个多对一的空间对接问题,不仅解决了数据集中缺口,而且解决了限制多模式野火分析的实际使用可扩展性缺口。 拟议设计的基本原理是:野生火的脆弱性是由特定地块的点火条件和周围的环境环境共同产生的,因此模型必须代表两者. 为此,我们提议在结构一级野火风险评估方面建立一个具有地理意识的多模式框架。 VLM首先从事前街景图象中提取出详细的建筑属性为结构化文本,而由卫星预导的DINOv3(Siméoni等,2025年)视觉基础模型则从相应的卫星补丁中提取出宏观层面的特征. 该框架然后通过将每个街景捕捉的纬度和经度绘图到卫星补丁内的相对像素坐标,将这个信号插入CLIP-编码(Radford等,2021年)文本特征,通过三种备选策略来弥补文本图像空间脱节: RoPE(Su等,2024年)用于相对依赖,RFF(Tancik等,2020年)用于绝对高维嵌入,并进行空间网格绘图,将文本特征放入其网格坐标处的2D空间开关. 交叉注意力聚变解码器最终将这些空间感知的文本特征与高架视觉特征相配合,生成结构层面的脆弱性预测. 图1说明了拟议工作流程。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed geolocation-aware multimodal framework for structure-level wildfire risk assessment. The pipeline addresses the limitations of isolated unimodal approaches by integrating macro-scale satellite imagery with micro-scale street-view data. A Vision-Language Model first extracts semantic building vulnerabilities from street-level images into structured text descriptions. To bridge the spatial disconnect between modalities, the geographical coordinates of the street-view captures are mapped to local relative coordinates and injected into CLIP-encoded text embeddings. A decoupled cross-attention multimodal fusion decoder then aligns these geolocation-aware text features with overhead visual features extracted via DINOv3. The proposed model processes these fused representations into pixel-wise risk labels, which are then transformed into a detailed, actionable community-scale wildfire risk map.
blocks.zh: 图1:结构层面野火风险评估的拟议地缘-认识多模式框架概述。 该管道通过将宏观规模的卫星图像同微观规模的街景数据相融合,解决孤立的单一方式方法的局限性。 一个Vision-Language Model首先将街平面图像的语义建筑脆弱性提取到结构化的文字描述中. 为弥合模式之间的空间脱节,将街景捕捉的地理坐标映射到本地相对坐标并注入CLIP编码文本嵌入. 然后,一个脱钩的交叉式多式聚变解码器将这些地缘感地文字特征与通过DINOv3提取的地上视觉特征相配合。 提议的模型将这些已连接到像素上的风险标签处理,然后转化为详细、可操作的社区规模野火风险地图。

blocks.en: Against this backdrop, the study pursues three linked objectives: (i) to develop a computationally tractable framework that integrates pre-event satellite imagery with street-view-derived structural semantics for structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment; (ii) to determine how ground-level information should be spatially anchored within overhead scenes through alternative geolocation embedding strategies; and (iii) to evaluate whether this multimodal, geolocation-aware design improves prediction quality and operational scalability in real WUI fire contexts. By testing the framework on the Eaton and Palisades fires and pairing ablation analysis with diagnostic experiments, the paper moves beyond proof-of-concept model building toward an evidence-based assessment of when and why multimodal spatial alignment matters.
blocks.zh: 在这一背景下,本研究追求三个相互关联的目标:(一) 制定可计算可操作的框架,将事前卫星图像同街景衍生的结构语义结合起来,用于结构层面的野火脆弱性评估;(二) 确定地面信息应如何通过替代地貌嵌入战略在高空场景中进行空间定位;以及(三) 评价这种多模式、地貌意识设计是否提高了真实的WUI火灾情况下的预测质量和业务可扩展性。 通过测试Eaton和Palisades火灾的框架,以及将衰竭分析与诊断实验结合起来,该文件超越了概念证明模型的构建,而转向对何时和为何多式联运空间相接很重要进行循证评估。

blocks.en: 2 Methodology
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: The proposed framework introduces a novel deep-learning architecture designed for the geolocation-aware multimodal fusion of overhead satellite imagery and ground-level street-view data. To manage computational overhead and extract structured building attributes, the raw street-view images are first converted into semantic text descriptions using a Vision-Language Model prior to multimodal fusion. To achieve highly accurate, structure-level wildfire vulnerability intelligence, the system overcomes the computational and spatial alignment bottlenecks of traditional multimodal models. It leverages pre-trained, frozen vision and language foundation models to extract robust macro-level visual features and micro-level semantic embeddings. The core of the framework is a custom, spatially-aware fusion decoder that aligns these disparate modalities by capturing explicit spatial dependencies before outputting precise building footprint and vulnerability maps. Figure 2 illustrates the proposed network architecture.
blocks.zh: 拟议框架引入了一种新的深层学习架构,旨在将高地卫星图像和地平面街景数据进行地平地-认识多模式组合。 为了管理计算间接费用并提取结构化的建筑属性,原始街景图像首先被转换为语义文字描述,在多模式融合之前使用Vision-Language模型. 为了实现高度准确,结构层次的野火脆弱性智能,该系统克服了传统多模式的计算和空间相配瓶颈. 它能利用被预先训练,被冷冻的视觉和语言基础模型来取出强壮的宏观视觉特征和微观的语义嵌入. 框架的核心是定制的、具有空间意识的聚变解码器,在输出精确的建筑脚印和脆弱性图之前,通过捕捉明确的空间依赖性来协调这些不同的模式。 图2说明了拟议的网络结构。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the model architecture. Ground-level street-view images are first processed by a Vision-Language Model to extract structured semantic attributes, which are combined with their geographic coordinates to form spatially anchored text embeddings. A multimodal fusion decoder then integrates these location-aware micro-level features with macro-level visual features extracted from pre-event satellite imagery via a frozen satellite-pretrained vision encoder to generate precise, structure-level wildfire risk maps.
blocks.zh: 图 2:示范建筑概述. 地平面街景图像首先由Vision-Language模型处理取出结构化的语义属性,这些属性与其地理坐标结合,形成空间定位的文字嵌入. 然后,一个多式聚变解码器将这些位置感知到的微型地平面特征与从事前卫星图像中提取的宏观地平面外观地平面相融合,通过被冷冻的卫星前置地平面外观编码器来生成精确,结构层次的野火风险图.

blocks.en: 2.1 Network Architecture
blocks.zh: 2.1 网络结构

blocks.en: The architecture is structured as a dual-encoder, single-decoder UNet-style network. It processes two distinct input streams: pre-event satellite image patches and a corresponding batch of VLM-derived text descriptions. The raw geographical coordinates of these street-view captures are first converted into localized, normalized coordinates prior to ingestion. This conversion maps the exact geographical location of the text description to a relative 2D pixel coordinate ( x , y ) (x,y) bounded between − 1 -1 and 1 1 within the paired satellite image patch, indicating exactly where the ground-level view sits within the specific overhead perspective. The network consists of four primary components: a Vision Encoder, a Language Encoder, a Multimodal Fusion Decoder, and Dual Segmentation Heads.
blocks.zh: 建筑结构为双层编解码器,单层编解码器UNet型网络. 它处理两个不同的输入流:事前卫星图像补丁和相应批次的VLM出自文本描述. 这些街景捕捉的原始地理坐标首先被转换为局部化,在摄入前实现坐标正常化. 这种转换将文本描述的确切地理位置映射到相配的卫星影像补丁内− 1 - 1和1之间的一个相对的2D像素坐标(x, y (x,y))上,准确显示地平面视图在具体高空视角内的位置. 网络由四个主要组成部分组成:一个远景编码器,一个语言编码器,一个多式融合解码器,以及双重分块头.

blocks.en: The visual pathway utilizes a DINOv3 ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) Vision Transformer (ViT-L/16) pre-trained on SAT-493M ( Siméoni et al., 2025 ) , a large satellite dataset, as its backbone. To retain the generalized feature representations learned during its extensive pre-training, the DINOv3 backbone is completely frozen. The backbone is wrapped in a custom adapter equipped with interaction blocks to extract hierarchical, multi-scale visual features from specific intermediate layers of the ViT, providing the decoder with a rich pyramid of macro-level contextual features.
blocks.zh: 视觉路径使用一台DINOv3 (Siméoni等,2025年) Vision Transformer(Vit-L/16)在SAT-493M(Siméoni等,2025年)上进行预训,这是一个大型卫星数据集。 为了保留在广泛预训期间学到的一般特征说明,DINOv3主干线被完全冻结. 骨干被包裹在一个自定义适配器上,并配备了互动块来从VIT的特定中间层中提取分级,多尺度的视觉特征,为解码器提供了丰富的宏级背景特征金字塔.

blocks.en: The textual pathway relies on a pre-trained, frozen CLIP ( Radford et al., 2021 ) text encoder (ViT-B/16). It is designed to handle a variable number of street-view text descriptions per satellite tile. The module tokenizes and encodes the raw text, passing the outputs through a linear projection layer to ensure the semantic feature dimensions match the embedding dimension of the visual backbone. To accommodate ragged inputs within a batch, the encoder constructs padded feature tensors and Boolean attention masks. Specifically, the encoder dynamically finds the maximum number of texts in a batch and pads the shorter sequences with zeros, marking them with an ignore mask. Crucially, this module processes and forwards the normalized 2D geographical coordinates associated with each text feature for downstream spatial alignment.
blocks.zh: 文本路径依赖于一个经过预先训练,被冻结的CLIP(Radford等,2021年)文本编码器(ViT-B/16). 其设计是为了处理每个卫星瓦片上可变数量的街景文字描述. 模块对原始文本进行符号化并编码,通过线性投影层传递输出,以确保语义特征维度与视觉主干线的嵌入维相匹配. 为了在批次内容纳被打乱的输入,编码器会构建出加固的特性开关和布尔注意力口罩. 具体而言,编码器动态地在一个批次中找到文本的最大数量,并用零来贴上较短的序列,用被忽略的口罩来标记. 关键是,本模块处理和转发与下游空间对接的每个文本特征相联的正态2D地理坐标.

blocks.en:
The decoder is the central fusion engine of the architecture. It operates across multiple stages, gradually upsampling the spatial resolution while integrating the multi-scale visual features via skip connections. At each stage, a two-way cross attention block performs the multimodal alignment.
Figure 3 illustrates the two-way cross attention block. To spatially ground the textual features, this block dynamically injects geolocation embeddings, derived from the normalized spatial coordinates, directly into the attention layers. (The specific positional embedding strategies explored to achieve this spatial awareness are detailed in Section 2.2 .) This is achieved using a decoupled attention mechanism inspired by the two-way transformer architecture of the Segment Anything Model (SAM) ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ) . Unlike standard transformer attention where positional data is baked into the input sequence before projection, decoupled attention mathematically separates spatial and semantic information. The positional embeddings are injected strictly into the queries ( Q Q ) and keys ( K K ) to dictate spatial routing, guiding exactly where the model should look and how features geometrically relate, while the values ( V V ) remain purely semantic. This ensures that the rich visual and textual data passed forward to the segmentation heads is highly spatially aware but untainted by coordinate transformations. The multimodal alignment occurs through a sequence of three such decoupled attention mechanisms:

解码器是建筑的中央聚变引擎. 它通过多个阶段运作,在通过跳过连接整合多尺度视觉特征的同时,逐渐提升空间分辨率. 在每一阶段,一个双向交叉注意力区块都进行多式联运的对接。
图3显示双向交叉注意力区块。 为了在空间上打出文字特征,这个块能动态地将从正态空间坐标得到的地理定位嵌入物直接注入了注意力层. (第2.2节详细介绍了为实现这种空间意识而探索的具体定位嵌入战略。 ) 实现这一点,需要利用由分块任何物模型(SAM)双向变压器结构所激发的脱钩注意机制(Kirillov等,2023年)。 与在投影前将位置数据烤入输入序列的标准变压器注意力不同,在数学上使注意力分离出空间和语义信息. 位置嵌入被严格地注入了查询(Q Q)和按键(K K),以支配空间路由,指导模型应该看的准确位置和特征几何关系,而值(V V)则保持纯语义. 这保证了向分层头所传递的丰富的视觉和文字数据在空间上具有高度的认识,但不会被坐标变换所夹杂. 多式联运对接是通过三个这种脱钩的注意机制进行的:

blocks.en: • Sparse Text Self-Attention (Text-to-Text): The localized text queries and keys interact with the injected spatial embeddings, allowing the text features to attend to one another and build a cohesive understanding of the ground-level scene based on their geometric relationships. • Sparse-to-Dense Cross-Attention (Text-to-Image): The spatially-aware text queries attend to the dense image features, updating the textual context based on the surrounding overhead visual data. • Dense-to-Sparse Cross-Attention (Image-to-Text): The dense image queries attend to the refined, spatially-anchored text features, effectively infusing the macro-level visual map with micro-level, ground-sourced semantic details.

blocks.en: 2.2 Geolocation Embeddings
blocks.zh: 2.2 地理定位

blocks.en: To ensure that the micro-level textual attributes are accurately anchored to the macro-level satellite basemap, the localized and normalized 2D geographical coordinates associated with each street-view semantic representation must be transformed into robust, high-dimensional representations. Because raw x x and y y coordinates lack the dimensionality required to effectively influence dense visual attention mechanisms, the framework evaluates three geolocation embedding strategies. Each method bridges the spatial disconnect by injecting geographical awareness into the multimodal fusion pipeline.
blocks.zh: 为确保微观层面的文字属性精确地定位在宏观层面的卫星基图上,必须把与每个街景语义表述相关的本地化和正态化的2D地理坐标转化为强而高维的表述. 由于生x和yy坐标缺乏有效影响密集视觉关注机制所需的维度,框架评价了三种地理定位嵌入策略. 每种方法都通过向多模式聚变管道注入地理意识来弥补空间脱节。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Rotary Positional Encoding (RoPE)

blocks.en: 2.3 Street-View Semantic Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.3 街-View语义特征提取

blocks.en: To derive localized building attributes from ground-level perspectives, the framework employs a Vision-Language Model (VLM), specifically GPT-4o ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , to process panoramic street-view imagery. The VLM is prompted to systematically evaluate the images and extract a comprehensive set of predefined structural and environmental characteristics, such as roof material, siding type, and vegetation-structure contact. The complete list of these predefined characteristics, the specific prompts utilized, and example outputs are detailed in Appendix S1.1 and S1.2 . The model outputs this micro-level data as structured, categorical key-value pairs, which are saved in JSON format. To maintain data integrity and prevent hallucination, the VLM is instructed to return the value “unsure” for any attribute that is visually obscured or undefinable from the given viewpoint.
blocks.zh: 为了从地平面角度获得局部建筑属性,该框架采用了一个视野-语言模型(VLM),具体来说是GPT-4o(OpenAI,2024),用于处理全景街景图像. 推动VLM系统评价图像,并提取一套完整的预先界定的结构和环境特征,如屋顶材料、平面类型和植被结构接触。 这些预先界定的特性的完整清单、使用的具体提示和实例产出详见附录S1.1和S1.2。 模型输出出这个微观层面的数据,作为结构化的,绝对的密钥值对,以JSON格式保存. 为了保持数据完整性并预防幻觉,VLM被指示返回任何从给定角度看似模糊或无法定义的属性的"不确定"值.

blocks.en: Generating highly efficient and accurate text embeddings requires isolating the most predictive building attributes while minimizing noise. To refine the extracted street-view semantic texts, recursive feature elimination with cross-validation is implemented using the training set. This automated feature selection process utilizes an XGBoost ( Chen and Guestrin, 2016 ) classifier as the base estimator, iteratively evaluating feature importance and dropping the single least important variable in each round. The optimization process is driven by the harmonic mean F1 score and rigorously validated using 5-fold stratified cross-validation, which guarantees that the original imbalanced class distribution of the dependent variable is proportionally preserved across every training and testing fold to prevent skewed evaluation metrics. Rather than relying on a manually defined threshold, the optimal number of independent variables is automatically determined by tracking the model’s performance iteratively and permanently selecting the exact feature subset size that yields the highest cross-validated peak score. This elimination strategy successfully identifies and removes 9 non-contributing features, a 36% reduction from an initial 25 features down to 16, without any degradation in overall model performance. The full list of features is detailed in Appendix S1.3 .
blocks.zh: 产生高效而准确的文字嵌入需要隔离最有预测性的建筑属性,同时将噪音降到最低. 为了完善所提取的街景语义文本,利用培训集实施有交叉验证的递归特征消除. 这个自动特性选择过程使用一个XGBoost(Chen and Guestrin, 2016)分类器作为基准估计器,迭接地评价特征重要性,并在每个回合中丢掉一个最不重要的变量. 优化过程由口琴平均分F1分来驱动,并使用5倍分级的分级交叉验证法进行严格验证,这保证了依赖变量最初不平衡的班级分布在每次培训和测试折叠中都按比例保存,以防止评价分数扭曲. 与其依赖人工定义的阈值,不如通过反复和永久地跟踪模型的性能来自动确定独立变量的最佳数量,从而得出最高跨验证峰值分数的精确特征子集大小. 这一消除战略成功确定并消除了9个非捐助特征,从最初的25个特征减少到16个,减少了36%,总体模型性能没有任何退化。 完整的特征清单详见附录S1.3.

blocks.en: Finally, the refined, structured data must be transformed back into a format suitable for the CLIP text encoder. A rule-based natural language generation pipeline performs a structured-to-unstructured conversion, translating the categorical feature dictionaries into coherent, comma-separated descriptive captions. If an attribute is successfully identified, the pipeline generates a precise phrase (e.g.,“wood structure”); if the VLM marked the attribute as “unsure”, the logic defaults to a generalized term (e.g., “building”). Regarding the identification of complex risk states, descriptive terms are omitted entirely if no risk is identified. For instance, if the VLM outputs “no power lines”, the pipeline does not explicitly describe this absence; rather, it excludes the attribute from the caption altogether. This preprocessing ensures that the final text inputs provided to the language encoder remain semantically dense and free of unnecessary noise. Examples of this conversion are detailed in Appendix S1.4 .
blocks.zh: 最后,经过精炼,结构化的数据必须被重新转化为适合CLIP文本编码器的格式. 基于规则的自然语言生成管道进行结构化到无结构化的转换,将绝对特征词典翻译成连贯的,逗号相分离的描述性标题. 如果一个属性被成功识别出,管道产生一个精确的短语(例如"木结构");如果VLM将属性标记为"不确定",逻辑默认为一个通用语(例如"建筑"). 关于确定复杂风险状态,如果不查明风险,则完全省略描述性术语。 例如,如果VLM输出“没有电线”,管道没有明确地描述这种缺失;相反,它完全排除了标题中的属性。 这种预处理可确保向语言编码器提供的最后文本输入保持密集而无不必要的噪音。 这种转换的例子详见附录S1.4。

blocks.en: 2.4 Street-View Localization
blocks.zh: 2.4 街道-村庄

blocks.en: To accurately anchor the ground-level semantic text features to the overhead satellite basemap, the precise geographic coordinates of the observed building facades must be calculated. Because raw street-view metadata only provides the coordinate of the vehicle or camera in the center of the street, the framework implements a geometric localization algorithm to project these coordinates onto the nearest adjacent structures. Simply linking the semantic text to the centroid of the nearest building is insufficient, as it results in a critical loss of view-angle information. A single structure is frequently captured by multiple street-view images from distinct vantage points; therefore, projecting the coordinates geometrically ensures that the exact observed facade and directional perspective are preserved within the spatial embedding.
blocks.zh: 为了准确地将地表语义文字特征固定在高空卫星基图上,必须计算所观测到的建筑物外观的精确地理坐标。 因为原始的街景元数据只提供街道中心车辆或相机的坐标,所以框架执行一个几何定位算法,将这些坐标投射到相邻最近的结构上. 将语义文本与最近的建筑的中间体连接起来是不够的,因为它造成了景角信息的重大损失. 单一的结构经常被来自不同优势点的多条街景图像所捕捉;因此,对坐标进行几何投影可确保在空间嵌入内保留准确的被观测到的外观和方向视角。

blocks.en: The algorithm processes each street-view capture by first defining a heading direction vector based on the camera’s recorded orientation. It then identifies the closest structures on both the left and right sides of the street. Once the target building is identified, a normal vector is cast orthogonally from the camera’s heading direction, clockwise for buildings on the right and counterclockwise for buildings on the left, as illustrated in Figure 4 . Using spherical trigonometry principles, the exact geospatial intersection point between the orthogonal street vector from the camera and the heading direction vector from the building center is calculated by representing their paths as great circles. Let 𝐧 s \mathbf{n}_{s} and 𝐧 b \mathbf{n}_{b} represent the 3D normal vectors defining the planes of the street’s great circle and the building’s great circle, respectively, derived from their spherical coordinates and bearings. The Cartesian intersection vector 𝐯 i ​ n ​ t \mathbf{v}_{int} is defined by their normalized cross product: 𝐯 i ​ n ​ t = ± 𝐧 s × 𝐧 b ‖ 𝐧 s × 𝐧 b ‖ \mathbf{v}_{int}=\pm\frac{\mathbf{n}_{s}\times\mathbf{n}_{b}}{\|\mathbf{n}_{s}\times\mathbf{n}_{b}\|} where the sign is selected to yield the intersection point closest to the original coordinates. This Cartesian vector ( x , y , z ) (x,y,z) is then converted back into the localized latitude ( ϕ i ​ n ​ t \phi_{int} ) and longitude ( λ i ​ n ​ t \lambda_{int} ) via: ϕ i ​ n ​ t = arcsin ⁡ ( z ) , λ i ​ n ​ t = arctan ⁡ 2 ​ ( y , x ) \phi_{int}=\arcsin(z),\quad\lambda_{int}=\arctan 2(y,x)

To preserve view-angle perspective, orthogonal normal vectors ( 𝐧 s \mathbf{n}_{s} ) are cast from the street-view camera’s heading direction. blocks.en: To prevent erroneous projections in sparse environments, where empty lots, missing structures, or deep setbacks might cause the algorithm to inadvertently project the intersection onto a distant, unrelated building, the algorithm enforces a maximum projection distance constraint. According to the City of Los Angeles Complete Streets Design Guide ( City of Los Angeles, 2025a ) , residential Rights-of-Way (ROW) generally range from roughly 8 meters on narrow hillside streets to 20 meters on standard collector streets. When standard front yard setbacks of 4.5 to 9 meters are added ( City of Los Angeles, 2025b ) , the total street corridor spans approximately 17 to 38 meters. Consequently, the expected projection distance from the camera’s origin at the street center to an adjacent building facade is roughly 8.5 to 19 meters. Therefore, a 25-meter threshold provides an adequate boundary to capture true adjacent facades while filtering out false positives. If the calculated intersection distance exceeds this limit, the localized point is automatically capped at the 25-meter mark along the orthogonal vector. The resulting localized coordinates, representing the exact observed facade location, are then normalized and fed into the multimodal decoder’s spatial embedding mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 为防止在稀疏环境中出现错误的预测,空地,缺失的结构,或深层挫折可能导致算法无意中将相交点投射到一个遥远的,无关的建筑上,算法执行最大投影距离限制. 根据"洛杉矶市完整街道设计指南"(City of Los Angeles, 2025a),住宅维权(ROW)一般从狭小的山坡街道上大约8米到标准采集者街道上20米. 当标准前院挫折4.5至9米被添加(洛杉矶市,2025b.)后,街道总走廊跨度约为17至38米. 因此,从街上中心的相机到相邻的建筑物外观的预计预测距离约为8.5至19米。 因此,一个25米的阈值提供了一个适当的边界,在过滤出假阳性时能够捕捉到相邻的真实外观. 如果计算出的相交距离超过这个极限,则会自动将局部点封入正向矢量沿25米的标记. 由此产生的局部坐标代表了所观察到的外观位置,然后正常化并输入多模式解码器的空间嵌入机制。

blocks.en: 2.5 Loss Function
blocks.zh: 2.5 函数丢失

blocks.en: Because the proposed framework simultaneously performs binary building localization and multi-class wildfire risk assessment, it is trained using a multi-task composite loss function. Both tasks inherently suffer from class imbalances. To mitigate this issue, the framework combines pixel-level entropy losses with structural overlap optimizations. Background pixels are ignored across all loss calculations.
blocks.zh: 由于拟议框架同时进行二进制建筑局部化和多级野火风险评估,因此采用多任务复合损失功能对其进行培训。 这两项任务都必然受到阶级不平衡的影响。 为了缓解这个问题,框架将像素级的 en损与结构重叠优化相结合. 在所有损失计算中忽略了背景像素。

blocks.zh: 2.5.1 本地化损失

blocks.en: For the wildfire risk classification task, the model must account for the ordinal nature of risk severity. Misclassifying an extreme-risk structure with as low risk is far more egregious than misclassifying it as high risk. Therefore, the classification loss replaces standard cross-entropy with a Distance-Weighted Cross-Entropy (WCE) loss, combined again with the Lovász-Softmax loss.

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: The proposed framework was evaluated using the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, California, as two real-world wildland–urban interface case studies. The experimental setup integrates pre-event satellite imagery, VLM-derived pre-event street-view semantic texts, building footprints, and post-event CAL FIRE damage inspection records to construct a multimodal benchmark for structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment. This section describes the study areas and data sources, the derivation of neighborhood-relative vulnerability labels from observed structural damage, the spatial partitioning and augmentation procedures used to prevent geographic data leakage, the model training configuration, and the evaluation metrics used to assess both building localization and wildfire vulnerability classification.
blocks.zh: 采用加利福尼亚州洛杉矶2025 Eaton和Palisades火灾作为两个真实世界的野地-城市界面案例研究对拟议框架进行了评估。 实验设置综合了事前卫星图像、VLM出自事前街景语义文本、脚印和事后CAL FIRE损害检查记录,以便为结构一级野火脆弱性评估构建一个多模式基准。 本节介绍研究领域和数据来源、从所观察到的结构损害中得出的邻里相对脆弱性标签、用于防止地理数据泄漏的空间分割和增强程序、示范培训配置以及用于评估建筑局部化和野火脆弱性分类的评价指标。

blocks.en: 3.1 Study Area
blocks.zh: 3.1 研究领域

blocks.en: The validation of the proposed framework was conducted using case studies centered on the 2025 Eaton Fire and the Palisades Fire in Los Angeles, California, which both ignited on January 7, 2025, and burned until their containment on January 31, 2025. The study area is shown in Figure 5 . These highly destructive wildland-urban interface fires were characterized by rapid spread across complex, steep topographies, leading to extensive and varied degrees of structural damage across residential neighborhoods. The selection of these major WUI fire events offers a robust and challenging real-world scenario for evaluating the capabilities of advanced, structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment methodologies. Critically, the availability of comprehensive ground truth data from post-event structural damage inspections for these specific regions, was a decisive factor in their selection for this research. The multimodal datasets subsequently employed for model training and evaluation are detailed below.
blocks.zh: 拟议的框架的验证是通过以2025年伊顿大火和加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的帕利萨德斯大火为核心的案例研究进行的,两者均于2025年1月7日被点燃,并被烧毁至2025年1月31日被封存. 研究领域见图5。 这些极具破坏性的野地-城市交接点火灾的特点是迅速蔓延到复杂而陡峭的地貌上,导致住宅区存在广泛而不同程度的结构破坏. 这些WUI重大火灾事件的选择为评估先进结构级野火脆弱性评估方法的能力提供了有力而具有挑战性的现实世界情景。 关键的是,从这些特定区域的活动后结构损害视察中获得全面的地面真相数据,是选择进行这项研究的一个决定性因素。 下文详述了随后用于示范培训和评价的多模式数据集。

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en: 3.2.1 Satellite Imagery
blocks.zh: 3.2.1 卫星 图像

blocks.en: The primary overhead visual inputs consisted of WorldView-3 pansharpened optical imagery with an approximately 0.30-m ground sampling distance. To ensure comprehensive coverage of the affected regions prior to the disaster events, the imagery was acquired through a combination of the Maxar Open Data Program ( Maxar Technologies, 2026 ) and Apollo Mapping ( Apollo Mapping, 2026 ) . All satellite images underwent orthomosaic processing to correct for topographic relief and camera tilt. For the Eaton Fire study area, pre-event imagery was captured on January 1, 2025. For the Palisades Fire study area, the pre-event imagery was acquired on October 20, 2024 and December 21, 2024. These pre-event acquisitions provided the foundational, macro-level landscape and structural context necessary for the assessments. In total, the study area was divided into 481 high-resolution 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 satellite image patches.
blocks.zh: 主要俯冲视觉输入由约0.30米地面取样距离的WorldView-3平面光学图像组成。 为确保灾前全面覆盖灾区,该影像通过Maxar开放数据方案(Maxar Technologies,2026年)和阿波罗测绘(Aporo Magazine,2026年)的结合获得. 所有卫星图像都经过了整形处理,以纠正地形减轻和相机倾斜。 对于伊通火灾研究区,2025年1月1日拍摄出事前影像. 为Palisades Fire研究区,事前图像于2024年10月20日和2024年12月21日被收购. 这些事前收购为评估提供了必要的基础、宏观和结构背景。 总共该研究区被分为481个高分辨率1024×1024 1024\times 1024卫星图像补丁.

blocks.en: 3.2.2 Street-View Imagery
blocks.zh: 3.2.2 街头影视

blocks.en: To capture the critical facade-level vulnerabilities that are invisible from overhead perspectives, ground-level visual data were acquired from Google Street View ( Anguelov et al., 2010 ) . For each identified building footprint within the study areas, panoramic street-view images were systematically retrieved. The data acquisition was temporally constrained to fetch the most recent available image captured between the years 2020 and 2024 for each structure. This five-year pre-event window was strategically selected to balance temporal accuracy with maximum spatial coverage. Because street-level mapping vehicles do not traverse every residential WUI road on an annual basis, utilizing a multi-year window ensures that a ground-level perspective is successfully retrieved for the vast majority of structures in the dataset while remaining recent enough to accurately represent the structural materials, siding types, and immediate defensible space present at the time of the disaster. Alongside the visual data, critical metadata encompassing the camera’s geographical coordinates and its heading direction in azimuth were recorded. This metadata serves as the foundational input for the geometric projection algorithm required to spatially anchor the ground-level attributes to the satellite basemap. This acquisition process resulted in a total of 16,577 localized panoramic street-view images.
blocks.zh: 为了捕捉从间接费用角度看不到的关键外观层面的脆弱性,从Google街景(Angelov等,2010年)获取了地面层面的视觉数据。 对于在研究区内确定的每个建筑脚印,系统检索了全景街景图像。 数据采集在时间上受到制约,无法获取2020年至2024年期间每个结构的最新图像。 这一为期五年的会前窗口是从战略上选择的,以平衡时间准确性和最大空间覆盖面。 由于街道一级的绘图工具不会每年穿越每条居民WUI公路,因此利用多年窗口确保成功取回数据集绝大多数结构的地平面视角,同时保持足够近的距离,以准确反映灾害发生时的结构材料、平面类型和即时可防御空间。 除了视觉数据外,还记录了包括相机地理坐标及其方位角方向的重要元数据。 这种元数据是几何投影算法的基础输入,它需要将地面属性以空间方式固定在卫星基图上。 这一收购过程共产生了16,577个局部全景街景图像.

blocks.en: 3.2.3 Ground Truth Data and Risk Derivation
blocks.zh: 3.2.3 地面真相数据和风险推导

blocks.en: The baseline ground truth data for post-event structural impacts was obtained from the CAL FIRE Damage Inspection (DINS) Database ( California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE), 2026 ) . The raw DINS dataset categorizes structural damage into five ordinal levels based on the percentage of physical destruction. The initial raw distribution consisted of 17,209 structures with no damage (0%), 1,847 affected (1–9%), 467 with minor damage (10–25%), 191 with major damage (26–50%), and 17,264 destroyed (>50%).
blocks.zh: 事件后结构影响的基线地面真实数据取自CAL FIRE损害检查数据库(加利福尼亚森林和防火部,2026年)。 原始的DINS数据集根据物理破坏的百分比将结构破坏分为五个正数级. 最初的原始分布包括17,209个没有损坏的建筑物(0%),1,847个受损(1-9%),467个轻微损坏(10-25%),191个重大损坏(26-50%)和17,264个被毁坏(>50%)。

blocks.en: However, utilizing absolute damage as the target variable for a vulnerability assessment presents a significant challenge. Absolute damage is heavily dominated by macroscopic fire spread dynamics, such as wind patterns or terrain-driven fire fronts. A destroyed building might simply have been in the direct path of an overwhelming firestorm rather than possessing inherently poor defensible space or vulnerable building materials, thereby obscuring its true, individual structural vulnerability.
blocks.zh: 然而,利用绝对损害作为脆弱性评估的目标变量是一项重大挑战。 绝对的破坏很大程度上以宏观的火灾蔓延动态为主,如风向模式或地势驱动的火锋等. 被摧毁的建筑物可能只是走在狂风暴雨的正路上,而不是拥有本来就贫瘠的可防御空间或脆弱的建筑材料,从而掩盖了它真正的个人结构脆弱性。

blocks.en: To isolate the inherent vulnerability of individual structures from these macroscopic fire behaviors, a relative risk scoring methodology was implemented. First, a spatially constrained agglomerative clustering approach, utilizing Ward’s minimum variance criterion ( Ward Jr, 1963 ) and implemented via the spopt Python library ( Feng et al., 2022 ) , was deployed to group the dataset into defined local neighborhoods based on geographic proximity and damage extent similarity. Within each neighborhood, the localized majority damage level was calculated to establish a baseline of the localized fire intensity. Next, a feature transformation was applied based on the premise that structures sustaining higher damage than their immediate neighbors possess a higher inherent risk, whereas structures that survive alongside destroyed neighbors demonstrate high structural resilience.
blocks.zh: 为了将单个结构的固有脆弱性与这些宏观火灾行为区分开来,采用了相对的风险评分方法。 首先,采用了空间受限的群集方法,利用Ward的最低差异标准(Ward Jr,1963年),并通过spopt Python图书馆(Feng等,2022年)实施,根据地理相近性和破坏程度相似性,将数据集组合成定义的本地社区。 在每个街区内,当地大部分破坏程度被计算出来,以确定当地火灾强度的基线. 其次,在以下前提下进行了特征转变:与近邻相比,破坏程度更高的结构具有较高的内在风险,而与被破坏的邻国毗邻生存下来的结构则显示出较高的结构复原力。

blocks.en: This relative risk score was calculated by determining the discrete deviation ( Δ \Delta ) between an individual structure’s ordinal damage class and its local neighborhood’s majority damage class. To preserve the ordinal granularity of the original five-tier inspection data while ensuring robust statistical representation, these deviations were symmetrically capped and mapped back onto a newly defined, five-tier ordinal wildfire risk scale. Structures that sustained damage perfectly consistent with their local micro-environment ( Δ = 0 \Delta=0 ) were designated as moderate risk (Class 2). Structures exhibiting higher comparative vulnerability were classified as high risk (Class 3) for a deviation of Δ = 1 \Delta=1 , while any deviation of Δ ≥ 2 \Delta\geq 2 was grouped into extreme risk (Class 4). This upper cap prevents extreme outliers from fracturing the dataset into overly sparse, unlearnable categories. Conversely, structures demonstrating higher resilience than their neighbors were assigned to low risk (Class 1) for Δ = − 1 \Delta=-1 , and minimal risk (Class 0) for all deviations of Δ ≤ − 2 \Delta\leq-2 . This spatial aggregation and transformation process shifted the target variables from absolute damage toward true structural vulnerability. The final preprocessed dataset utilized for model training and evaluation yielded 8,224 minimal risk, 4,072 low risk, 6,807 moderate risk, 7,441 high risk, and 10,434 extreme risk structures. These refined labels serve as the ground truth for the framework’s risk classification task.
blocks.zh: 这一相对风险分数的计算方法是确定单个结构的平分损害类与本地邻居的大多数损害类之间的离散偏差。 为了保持原始的五级检查数据的正线颗粒性,同时确保有力的统计代表性,这些偏差对称地被封住并被映射回新界定的五级正线野火风险尺度上. 受到完全符合当地微观环境(QQ=0\Delta=0)的损害的结构被指定为中度风险(第2类)。 相对脆弱性较高的结构被归类为高风险(第3类),偏差为: = 1\ Delta=1;而偏差为: → 2\ Delta\geq 2的任何偏差被归类为极端风险(第4类)。 这种上盖防止极端外出者将数据集分解为过于稀少的,不易学习的类别. 反之,显示比邻居具有较高复原力的结构被分配到XQ=- 1\Delta=-1的低风险(第1级)和XQ=-2\Delta\leq-2的所有偏差的最低风险(第0级)。 这一空间聚合和转变过程将目标变量从绝对损害转向真正的结构脆弱性。 用于示范培训和评价的最后预处理数据集产生了8 224个最低风险、4 072个低风险、6 807个中度风险、7 441个高风险和10 434个极端风险结构。 这些经过改进的标签是框架风险分类任务的基本真相。

blocks.en: 3.2.4 Building Footprints
blocks.zh: 3.2.4 建筑脚印

blocks.en: The delineation of building boundaries is essential for both the building localization task and the spatial aggregation of pixel-wise risk predictions. Georeferenced building footprint vector data were acquired from the County of Los Angeles Open Data portal ( County of Los Angeles, 2026 ) . These vector footprints served two primary functions within the experimental framework. First, they were rasterized to generate the binary ground truth building masks utilized to train and evaluate the model’s building localization function. Second, these geographic boundaries were employed during the inference and evaluation phases to spatially group the model’s pixel-level risk classifications, thereby computing the building-level metric and generating the final actionable wildfire risk maps.
blocks.zh: 建筑界限的划定对于建筑本地化任务和对像素风险预测进行空间汇总至关重要。 从洛杉矶县开放数据门户(洛杉矶县,2026年)获取了地理参照建筑脚印矢量数据. . 这些向量足迹在实验框架内可发挥两项主要功能。 首先,它们被光栅化,生成二元地面真相建筑口罩,用来训练和评估模型的建筑本地化功能。 第二,在推论和评估阶段使用了这些地理界限,以在空间上划分模型的像素级风险分类,从而计算出建筑级的计量标准并绘制出可操作的最后野火风险图。

blocks.zh: 3.3 数据准备和补充

blocks.en: A spatial pairing process was executed to associate the satellite image tiles with their corresponding discrete street-view text descriptions. First, the algorithm isolated only the textual data points that geographically intersected the bounding box of a given image tile. Then, the real-world geographic coordinates of these intersecting points were converted into 2D pixel coordinates relative to the image tensor. The extracted text features and their calculated pixel coordinates were then compiled into structured JSON files, establishing a many-to-one mapping between the localized ground-level attributes and each overhead basemap tile.

blocks.en: Following this pairing process, the dataset was partitioned into training (60%), validation (20%), and testing (20%) subsets. To strictly prevent spatial data leakage, standard random sampling was intentionally avoided during dataset partitioning. Instead, a spatial splitting method was employed while maintaining a similar damage data distribution across subsets, ensuring rigorously isolated training, validation, and testing subsets. During the training phase, 512 × 512 512\times 512 pixel tiles were randomly cropped from the satellite image tiles and their corresponding ground truth masks. To enhance the model’s generalization capabilities, these training inputs were subjected to spatial augmentations, including random rotations, horizontal flips, and vertical flips. Additionally, standard normalization procedures were applied to all input imagery prior to processing.
blocks.zh: 在此配对过程之后,数据集被分为培训(60%),验证(20%)和测试(20%)子集. 为了严格防止空间数据泄露,在数据集分割过程中有意避免标准随机采样. 相反,采用了空间分割方法,同时在子集之间保持类似的损害数据分布,确保严格隔离的培训、验证和测试子集。 在培训阶段,512×512 512\times 512像素瓦被从卫星图像瓦及其相应的地面真假口罩上随机收割. 为提高模型的通俗化能力,这些培训投入需要空间增强,包括随机旋转、水平翻转和垂直翻转。 此外,标准正常化程序适用于处理前的所有输入图像。

blocks.en: Because the proposed framework explicitly aligns these localized street-view text descriptions with specific geographic locations within the satellite basemap, any geometric transformation applied to the visual inputs must be synchronized with the point coordinates of the text descriptions. To maintain this spatial integrity, custom augmentation functions were implemented to recalculate the pixel coordinates of the street-view text descriptions alongside the image tensors.
blocks.zh: 由于拟议框架明确将这些本地化的街景文字描述与卫星基图内的具体地理位置相配合,任何适用于视觉输入的几何转换都必须与文字描述的点坐标同步. 为了保持这种空间完整性,实施了自定义增强功能来重新计算街道-视图文本描述的像素坐标和图像亮度。

blocks.en: 3.4 Training Configuration
blocks.zh: 3.4 培训配置

blocks.en: The proposed vision-language framework was optimized using the AdamW optimizer. To preserve the robust, generalized feature representations learned during the DINOv3 foundation model’s pretraining, the backbone network was completely frozen. Consequently, only the newly initialized parameters within the adapter layers and decoder heads were actively trained, utilizing an initial learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . A weight decay of 1 × 10 − 2 1\times 10^{-2} was applied across all trainable parameters. These specific hyperparameter values were empirically determined through preliminary experiments to optimize model performance and stabilize the training trajectory.
blocks.zh: 拟议的远景语言框架利用AdamW优化器进行了优化。 为了保留DINOv3基础模型前期训练期间学到的强健而通俗的特征表述,骨干网络被完全冻结. 因此,只有适配器层和编解码器头的新初始参数得到了积极培训,采用了1×10−4 1\times 10×4}的初始学习率。 重量衰减为1×10−2 1\times 10×2}适用于所有可列车参数。 这些具体的超参数值通过初步实验经验确定,以优化模型性能并稳定训练轨迹.

blocks.en: For the composite loss function, the weights for the cross-entropy loss λ c ​ e \lambda_{ce} for both the building localization and wildfire vulnerability assessment tasks were set to 1.0 1.0 . The weight for the Lovasz-Softmax loss applied to the building localization task λ l ​ o ​ v l ​ o ​ c \lambda_{lov}^{loc} was set to 0.5 0.5 . Recognizing the multi-class vulnerability assessment as the primary, more complex objective of the framework, the weight for its corresponding Lovasz-Softmax loss component λ l ​ o ​ v c ​ l ​ f \lambda_{lov}^{clf} was assigned a higher value of 0.75 0.75 to further heavily penalize IoU errors in the minority risk classes.
blocks.zh: 关于综合损失功能,建筑物局部化和野火脆弱性评估任务的跨纵横损失的权重被定为1.01.0。 Lovasz-Softmax损失的重量被设定为0.5。 由于认识到多类脆弱性评估是该框架的首要、更复杂的目标,因此将相应Lovasz-Softmax损失部分的权重定为0.75 0.75, 以进一步严厉惩罚少数风险类别中的IoU错误。

blocks.en: All models were trained for a total of 100 epochs with an effective batch size of 16. Due to the high GPU memory demands associated with processing high-resolution visual inputs and large language feature embeddings, this was implemented using a true batch size of 2 complemented by 8 gradient accumulation steps. During the testing and inference phase, the model processed the input data at its original, uncropped resolution of 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 pixels to generate the final structural vulnerability predictions.
blocks.zh: 所有型号共为100个纪元进行了培训,有效批量规模为16个. 由于与处理高分辨率视觉输入和大型语言特性嵌入相关的高GPU内存需求,使用2个真实批量大小并辅以8个梯度积累步骤来实施. 在测试和推论阶段,该模型在最初的1024×1024 1024\times 1024像素的解析中处理了输入数据,以生成最终的结构脆弱性预测.

blocks.en: 3.5 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.5 评价计量

blocks.en: Model performance is evaluated using F1 scores, which provide a balanced assessment of precision and recall. Precision measures the accuracy of the positive predictions, while recall measures the model’s ability to identify all actual positive instances. They are defined as P ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n = T ​ P T ​ P + F ​ P , R ​ e ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ l = T ​ P T ​ P + F ​ N Precision=\frac{TP}{TP+FP},\quad Recall=\frac{TP}{TP+FN} where T ​ P TP , F ​ P FP , and F ​ N FN represent the number of true positives, false positives, and false negatives, respectively. The standard F1 score is then defined as the harmonic mean of these two metrics: F ​ 1 = 2 ⋅ P ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n ⋅ R ​ e ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ l P ​ r ​ e ​ c ​ i ​ s ​ i ​ o ​ n + R ​ e ​ c ​ a ​ l ​ l F1=2\cdot\frac{Precision\cdot Recall}{Precision+Recall} The building footprint extraction is evaluated using a binary pixel-level F1 score ( F ​ 1 l ​ o ​ c F1_{loc} ). For the wildfire risk assessment, the F1 score is calculated independently for each risk class. To provide a single, robust classification metric, these individual scores are aggregated using a harmonic mean F1 score ( F ​ 1 c ​ l ​ f F1_{clf} ). By using a harmonic mean rather than an arithmetic mean, the metric penalizes models that perform poorly on minority classes. blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: The experimental evaluation examines the proposed framework from four complementary perspectives. First, three geolocation embedding strategies are compared to determine how localized street-view semantics can be most effectively anchored within overhead satellite features. Second, the predictive performance of the selected configuration is evaluated at both pixel and building levels. Third, ablation experiments quantify the contributions of satellite imagery, street-view semantic information, and explicit geolocation encoding. Finally, a controlled label-reconstruction experiment isolates the model’s spatial-alignment capability from limitations in the semantic information extracted from real-world street-view imagery.
blocks.zh: 试验性评价从四个互补角度审查拟议框架。 首先,比较了三种地理定位嵌入战略,以确定如何能最有效地将本地化的街景语义定位在卫星地上。 其次,选定配置的预测性能在像素和建筑两级都得到评价. 第三,消融实验量化了卫星图像、街景语义信息和明确的地貌编码的贡献。 最后,一个有控制的标签重建实验将模型的空间调节能力与从现实世界街景图象中提取的语义信息的限制相隔离.

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison of Geolocation Embeddings
blocks.zh: 4.1 地理定位嵌入物比较

blocks.en: To determine the optimal strategy for encoding the geographic coordinates of the street-view text descriptions into the multimodal architecture, a comparative analysis was conducted evaluating three distinct geolocation embedding techniques: Rotary Position Embedding, Random Fourier Features, and Spatial Grid Mapping. The quantitative results of this comparison are summarized in Table 1 . The RoPE strategy emerged as the significantly superior approach, achieving the highest overall harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for the building wildfire risk classification task and the best building localization F1 score of 0.6735. Crucially, RoPE demonstrated the most robust capability in identifying critical structural vulnerabilities, dominating the moderate, high, and extreme risk categories.
blocks.zh: 为确定将街景文字描述的地理坐标编码入多模式架构的最佳战略,进行了比较分析,评价了三种不同的地理定位嵌入技术: 旋转位置嵌入、随机傅里叶地物和空间网格绘图。 表1概述了这一比较的量化结果。 ROPE战略以显著优异的方式出现,实现建筑野火风险分级任务最高整体口服平均分F1分0.2476分,最佳建筑本地化F1分0.6735分. 至关重要的是,促进平等办公室在识别关键结构脆弱性、主导中度、高度和极端风险类别方面表现出最强的能力。

blocks.en: In contrast, while the Random Fourier Features method matched RoPE’s computational efficiency at 100 million parameters and provided highly competitive building localization performance with F1 score of 0.6699, it generally yielded lower predictive accuracy across the more severe risk categories, resulting in a reduced harmonic mean of 0.2198. The Spatial Grid Mapping method proved to be suboptimal for this architecture. Despite significantly inflating the model’s complexity to 349 million trainable parameters, it suffered a catastrophic failure in learning the moderate risk class, yielding an F1 score of zero which subsequently collapsed the overall harmonic mean to zero. Furthermore, its building localization performance degraded severely to 0.2284. These findings clearly validate the selection of RoPE as the primary geolocation embedding mechanism.
blocks.zh: 相形之下,Random Fourier Features方法在1亿个参数上与ROPE的计算效率相匹配,并提供了具有高度竞争力的建筑本地化性能,F1得分为0.6699分,但一般在更严重的风险类别中得出了更低的预测精度,导致口音平均值降低为0.2198分. 事实证明,空间网格绘图方法对于这一架构来说并不理想。 尽管模型的复杂性大幅膨胀到3.49亿可训练参数,但它在学习中度风险等级时遭遇了灾难性的失败,获得了F1分的零分,随后整体口音平均值崩溃为零. 此外,其建筑局部化性能严重地退化到0.2284分. 这些结论明确证明选择RoPE作为主要地理定位嵌入机制是正确的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Structure-Level Risk Prediction Performance
blocks.zh: 4.2 结构层面的风险预测绩效

blocks.en: To qualitatively assess the framework’s predictive capabilities, Figure 6 visualizes the pixel-level risk predictions generated by the optimal model utilizing RoPE geolocation embeddings, alongside their corresponding ground-truth localized building risk maps. As observed in the visual comparisons, the model effectively captures the broad spatial distribution of structural vulnerabilities, demonstrating a particularly strong capability in delineating minimal, high, and extreme risk clusters. However, structures within the low and moderate risk tiers are more susceptible to misclassification, a limitation likely attributable to the lack of highly distinguishable visual and textual characteristics differentiating these intermediate vulnerability levels.

blocks.en: For a rigorous quantitative evaluation, the model’s performance was assessed across both the raw pixel outputs and building-level aggregations. Pixel-level F1 scores evaluate the direct output of the multimodal decoder. However, because wildfire vulnerability is fundamentally a structure-level attribute, the pixel predictions were subsequently aggregated within the boundaries of the building footprints using majority voting to calculate building-level F1 scores. Recognizing the inherent ordinal nature of the wildfire risk scale, we also report adjacent F1 and upper adjacent F1 scores. The comprehensive results across these metrics are detailed in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 为了进行严格的定量评价,该模型的业绩在原始像素产出和建筑物一级的汇总中都得到了评估。 像素级F1分数评价了多模式解码器的直接输出. 然而,由于野火脆弱性从根本上来说是一个结构层面的属性,因此像素预测随后被汇总在建筑脚印的边界内,利用多数投票来计算建筑级别F1分. 认识到野火风险等级表的内在正则性质,我们还报告相邻的F1和相邻上方的F1分数. 表2详细列出了这些衡量标准的综合结果。

blocks.en: The results in Table 2 reveal critical insights into the framework’s error distribution and predictive bias. By analyzing the differences between the strict, adjacent, and upper adjacent metrics, distinct behavioral tendencies emerge across the risk scale. Crucially, the framework exhibits a conservative, fail-safe bias in the higher vulnerability tiers. For both the moderate and extreme classes, the upper adjacent metric accounts for the vast majority of the improvement observed in the full adjacent score. For the moderate class, the score improves from a strict F1 of 0.2241 to an upper adjacent F1 of 0.2628, capturing almost all of the full adjacent score’s total increase to 0.2717. Similarly, the extreme class jumps from a strict F1 of 0.2173 to an upper adjacent score of 0.2884, which closely mirrors its maximum full adjacent score of 0.2937. This signifies that when the model struggles to perfectly classify a structure, it predominantly errs on the side of caution by overestimating the risk. Specifically, because the extreme class is the highest possible category, the notable improvement in its upper adjacent score mathematically confirms that the model frequently flags high-risk ground-truth structures as extreme. Similarly, moderate structures are more likely to be conservatively elevated to the high-risk category than downgraded. Despite this conservative bleed-over into the extreme class, the high-risk category demonstrates consistently robust performance across all three metrics, maintaining a strict F1 of 0.7481, an upper adjacent F1 of 0.7670, and a full adjacent F1 of 0.7705. In the context of disaster management, confidently isolating high-risk structures while being conservative via over-prediction in ambiguous intermediate cases is a highly desirable characteristic. Conversely, an under-prediction bias is evident at the lower end of the scale. For the low-risk category, the F1 score drastically improves from 0.1993 to 0.5058 under the full adjacent constraint, yet the upper adjacent F1 only reaches 0.2146. This reveals that the model frequently misses the subtle visual and textual cues distinguishing minimal from low risk, causing it to systematically misclassify low-risk structures as minimal.
blocks.zh: 表2的结果显示了对框架错误分布和预测偏差的重要见解。 通过分析严格、相邻和上相邻的度量标准之间的差异,在整个风险尺度上出现了明显的行为趋势。 关键的是,该框架显示出在较高脆弱性层次存在保守的、不可靠的偏见。 对于中和极端阶层来说,上相邻的度量衡占了在完全相邻分数中观察到的绝大多数改进. 对于中产阶级,分数从严格的F10.2241提高到上相邻的F10.2628,捕捉了相邻的全部分数几乎全部增加为0.2717. 同样地,极端班级从严格的F1起0.2173起跳到上相邻的0.2884起跳取分,这密切地反映了其最大全相邻的0.2937起跳取分. 这说明当模型试图将一个结构完美分类时,它通过高估风险而主要在谨慎方面是错误的。 具体来说,由于极端类是尽可能高的类别,其上相邻分数的显著改善在数学上证实了模型经常将高风险地-真实结构标为极端. 同样,中度结构更可能保守地被提升到高风险类别,而不是被降级。 尽管这种保守的出血进入了极端阶层,但高风险类别在所有三个度量标准中都表现出了一贯的强性能,保持了严格的F1为0.7481,上相邻的F1为0.7670,而全相邻的F1为0.7705. 在灾害管理方面,充满信心地孤立高风险结构,同时在模棱两可的中间情况下通过过度预测而保守,这是一个非常可取的特点。 相反地,在比额表的下端明显存在预测不足的偏差。 对于低风险类别,在完全相邻的制约下,F1的得分从0.1993大幅提升到0.5058,而上相邻的F1只达到0.2146. 这表明,该模型往往忽略了区分最低风险和低风险的细微视觉和文字提示,使其系统地将低风险结构归类为最低风险。

blocks.en: 4.3 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.3 阅读研究

blocks.en: To rigorously evaluate the contribution of each architectural component within the proposed framework, comprehensive ablation studies were conducted. Specifically, the experiments aimed to isolate the individual impacts of the input modalities as well as the efficacy of the geometric spatial alignment provided by the Rotary Position Embedding mechanism. The quantitative results of these configurations are detailed in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 为了严格评价拟议框架内每个建筑部分的贡献,进行了全面的建筑研究。 具体地说,这些实验旨在隔离输入方式的个别影响以及由扶轮姿势嵌入机制提供的几何空间对接的效果。 这些配置的量化结果详见表3。

blocks.en: The baseline unimodal models demonstrated expected limitations when operating in isolation. The model utilizing only satellite imagery achieved a competitive building localization F1 score of 0.6527, leveraging the clear geometric boundaries visible from overhead perspectives. However, it struggled significantly with the building wildfire risk classification task, yielding a low harmonic mean F1 of 0.1450. Conversely, the unimodal model relying solely on unanchored street-view text descriptions completely failed at localization and classification, with F1 scores of 0.0884 and 0.0764, respectively, underscoring that semantic descriptions without spatial context are insufficient. When RoPE was introduced to the text-only model, classification performance rebounded dramatically to a harmonic mean of 0.1964, proving that spatially structuring the text is critical without visual data.
blocks.zh: 基线单一模式模型表明,在孤立运作时,预期会有局限性。 该模型仅利用卫星图像,实现了具有竞争力的建筑物本地化F1分数为0.6527分,利用了从高层角度可见的清晰几何边界。 然而,它与"建筑野火"风险分级任务相去甚远,产生低口音平均值F1为0.1450. 反之,单模式完全依赖无序街景文字描述在本地化和分类上完全失败了,F1的分数分别为0.0884分和0.0764分,强调没有空间背景的语义描述是不够的. RoPE被引入文本专用模型后,分类性能被大幅反弹为0.1964的口琴平均值,证明没有视觉数据,空间结构的文本至关重要.

blocks.en: The advantages of the multimodal approach become evident when both data sources are fused. Simply integrating the satellite imagery and text descriptions without geographic embeddings improved the overall risk classification harmonic mean to 0.2115, outperforming both unimodal baselines. However, the full potential of the framework was only realized when the multimodal inputs were coupled with the RoPE geolocation embeddings. This finalized architecture achieved the highest overall performance across both tasks, achieving the highest harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 and boosting building localization to an F1 score of 0.6735. These results confirm the core hypothesis of this research that overhead imagery provides the essential macro-level geometric context, but spatially anchoring ground-level semantic vulnerabilities via precise geometric projection is necessary to accurately assess structure-level wildfire risk.
blocks.zh: 当两个数据来源相互连接时,多式联运方法的优点就很明显了。 简单地将卫星图像和文字描述结合,而不进行地理嵌入,将总体风险分类口号提高到了0.2115,优于两种单一模式基线。 然而,只有当多式联运投入与RoPE地理定位嵌入物相配合时,框架才充分发挥潜力。 这个最终完成的架构在两项任务中都实现了最高的整体性能,实现了最高的口琴平分F1分0.2476分,将建筑本地化提升为F1分0.6735分. 这些结果证实了这一研究的核心假设,即:高空图像提供了基本的宏观层面几何背景,但通过精确几何预测在空间上锁定地层语义上的脆弱性对于准确评估结构层面的野火风险是必要的.

blocks.en: 4.4 Label Reconstruction Diagnostic Experiment
blocks.zh: 4.4 标签重建诊断实验

blocks.en: While the ablation studies demonstrated that the Rotary Position Embedding improved the framework’s performance, the magnitude of the improvement provided by the geolocation embeddings on the primary task was less significant than anticipated. To investigate whether this limitation stemmed from the architectural mechanism of the spatial embeddings or from the inherent nature of the street-view text descriptions themselves, a label reconstruction diagnostic experiment was conducted.
blocks.zh: 虽然减退研究显示,扶轮机位置嵌入改进了框架的绩效,但地理定位嵌入主要任务所带来的改进程度不如预期大。 为了调查这一限制是源于空间嵌入的建筑机制,还是源于街景文字描述本身的固有性质,进行了标签重建诊断实验.

blocks.en: In this controlled experiment, the street-view text descriptions were replaced with explicit ground-truth risk level labels passed as the text input. The objective was to determine if the model could successfully reconstruct the building-level vulnerability maps when given perfect textual information, thereby isolating the model’s capacity to spatially anchor text to visual features. The quantitative results are presented in Table 4 .
blocks.zh: 在这个有控制的实验中,街景文本描述被替换为作为文本输入而传递的明确地-真实风险级别标签. 目的是确定该模型在获得完美的文字信息后是否能够成功地重建建筑一级的脆弱性图,从而将模型在空间上将文字定位到视觉特征的能力隔离开来。 量化结果见表4。

blocks.en: In contrast to the primary task, explicit geolocation encoding produced substantially larger gains in the label-reconstruction experiment. Without geolocation embeddings, the model achieved a harmonic mean F1 of 0.3458; this increased to 0.4466 with RoPE and 0.5329 with RFF. These results demonstrate that the fusion architecture can effectively exploit explicit spatial anchors when highly informative textual inputs are available. The smaller gains observed with real-world VLM-derived descriptions therefore likely reflect limitations in the semantic information extracted from street-view imagery rather than an inability of the model to utilize geolocation information.
blocks.zh: 与主要任务不同的是,明确的地理编码在标签重建实验中产生了显著更大的收益。 没有地理定位嵌入,该模型实现了0.3458的口琴正弦F1;这与ROPE相接后增加到了0.4466,与RFF相接后增加到了0.5329. 这些结果表明,如果能够提供内容丰富的文字投入,聚变结构可以有效地利用明确的空间锚地。 因此,从真实世界VLM生成的描述中观察到的较小的进展可能反映了从街景图象中提取的语义信息方面的局限性,而不是模型无法利用地理定位信息。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: The most innovative aspect of this study is that it shows how structure-level wildfire vulnerability can be inferred by spatially aligning semantically compressed ground evidence with continuous overhead imagery, rather than by forcing direct pixel-to-pixel fusion across viewpoints. Empirically, the results validate this design choice: the full multimodal model with Rotary Positional Encoding achieved the best localization score ( F ​ 1 = 0.6735 F1=0.6735 ) and the strongest five-class risk classification performance (harmonic mean F ​ 1 = 0.2476 F1=0.2476 ), outperforming both the unimodal baselines and the unanchored multimodal configuration. The remainder of this section interprets why this geolocation-aware alignment prevailed over alternative methods, examines its operational significance for wildland–urban interface risk management, and delineates the boundaries of the current framework.
blocks.zh: 本研究最有创意的一面是,它表明如何通过空间上将精密压缩的地面证据与连续的俯仰图像相配合,而不是通过强迫直接像素到像素的异位聚变来推断出结构层面的野火脆弱性. 经验证明,结果验证了这一设计选择:带有Rotary定位编码的全多式模型实现了最佳本地化分数(F 1 = 0.6735 F1 = 0.6735)和最强的五等风险分级分级性能(谐音指F 1 = 0.2476 F1 = 0.2476),优于单式基准和未选取的多式配置. 本节的其余部分解释为何这种地理意识协调优先于其他方法,研究其对野地-城市界面风险管理的业务意义,并划定目前框架的界限。

blocks.en: The comparative experiments, specifically the contrast between the real-world dataset (Table 1 ) and the label reconstruction diagnostic (Table 4 ), highlight the nuanced role of spatial embeddings in multimodal reasoning. While Random Fourier Features excelled in the diagnostic task, Rotary Position Embedding proved superior for the primary real-world application. This divergence stems directly from their underlying mathematical mechanisms. RFF is an additive method that injects high-frequency, absolute coordinate anchors directly into the feature vectors. While this acts as a highly effective spatial hash for memorizing locations when the input is a perfectly certain ground-truth label, adding this high-frequency positional wave data to real-world, noisy natural language vectors disrupts and washes out their subtle semantic meanings. Conversely, RoPE employs a multiplicative approach, rotating feature vectors in complex space. This preserves the delicate semantic magnitude of the nuanced street-view descriptions while seamlessly injecting spatial awareness based on relative distances, making it uniquely suited for complex multimodal reasoning. Furthermore, the overall magnitude of improvement from geolocation embeddings was less pronounced in the real-world task compared to the diagnostic task. This discrepancy is primarily driven by the presence of implicit spatial baselines. VLM-derived street-view descriptions inherently contain rich visual semantics that the multimodal cross-attention mechanisms can implicitly align with the corresponding overhead visual features. Because the vision backbone naturally establishes this correspondence, explicit geolocation embeddings act merely as a fine-grained spatial refinement rather than building spatial awareness from scratch. Conversely, the diagnostic target labels contain no visual semantic information. Without these implicit visual cues to guide the attention routing, the diagnostic model relies entirely on the explicit geolocation embeddings to pin the text to the geographic grid, resulting in a massive performance spike when they are introduced. Finally, real-world performance is naturally constrained by the purity of the input signal; the street-view text is inherently noisy, occasionally ambiguous, capping the overall performance ceiling compared to the purely spatial memorization exercise utilizing 100% certain ground-truth labels.
blocks.zh: 比较实验,特别是真实世界数据集(表1)和标签重建诊断(表4)之间的对比,突出了空间嵌入在多模式推理中的细微作用. 虽然Random Fourier的特性在诊断任务方面表现优异,但Rotary Place Embedding在主要现实世界应用方面却被证明是优异的。 这种差异直接源于它们的基本数学机制。 RFF是一种将高频,绝对坐标锚地直接注入特征向量的添加剂方法. 虽然在输入是完全确定地面真实的标签时,这种空间散列是一种高度有效的空间散列,在现实世界中添加这种高频位置波数据,但吵闹的自然语言向量干扰并洗刷出其微妙的语义意义. 反之,ROPE采用多相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 这保留了细微的街景描述的微妙语义量,同时在相对距离的基础上无缝地注入了空间意识,使其特别适合复杂的多模式推理. 此外,与诊断任务相比,在现实世界任务中,地理定位嵌入的总体改进程度并不明显。 这种差异主要是由于存在隐含的空间基线。 VLM出自街景的描述本身就包含着丰富的视觉语义,而多式交叉取景机制可以暗含地与相应的俯仰视觉特征相配合. 由于视觉主干自然地建立了这种对应关系,所以明确的地理定位嵌入只是一种精细的空间改进,而不是从零开始建立空间意识. 相反,诊断目标标签中并没有视觉语义信息. 没有这些隐含的视觉提示来引导注意力的去向,诊断模型完全依靠明确的地理定位嵌入来将文字钉入地理网格上,从而在引入时产生出巨大的性能突起. 最后,真实世界的性能自然受到输入信号的纯度的限制;街景文本本质上是吵闹的,偶尔是模糊的,与使用100%地用地上真实标记的纯粹空间记忆活动相比,将总体性能上限封顶.

blocks.en: Despite the inherent noise within real-world street-view descriptions and the complexity of cross-modal alignment, the proposed multimodal fusion successfully achieves an operational solution highly suited for disaster management. Beyond predictive reliability, the text-based dimensionality reduction allows the framework to demonstrate exceptional scalability. The core multimodal architecture achieves a pure inference speed of 3.79 seconds per 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 -pixels tile. Consequently, when executing the complete end-to-end operational pipeline sequentially with a batch size of 1, including data loading, model inference, and the generation of georeferenced risk maps, the framework assessed approximately 36,978 structures across the study area in just 37 minutes on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000. It is important to note that this unoptimized, sequential measurement is reported specifically to establish a baseline performance floor; in a true operational deployment, leveraging parallel processing and larger batch sizes would significantly reduce this execution time. By aggregating pixel predictions to structural boundaries, the model mitigates localized noise and demonstrates a valuable conservative bias. As discussed in the experimental results, the framework confidently isolates high-risk structures while tending to over-predict vulnerability in ambiguous, intermediate cases rather than under-predicting it. In the context of community resilience planning, this combination of rapid, large-scale processing and a fail-safe margin ensures that emergency managers and policymakers can efficiently triage resources across expansive WUI environments without overlooking highly susceptible homes.
blocks.zh: 尽管现实世界街头观描述中固有的噪音和跨模式组合的复杂性,拟议的多模式组合成功地实现了非常适合灾害管理的可操作解决方案。 除了预测性可靠性外,以文字为基础的维度减少使框架能够显示特殊的可伸缩性。 核心多模式架构实现纯推断速度为3.79秒每1024×1024-1024\times 1024-像素瓦. 因此,当按批次1相继执行完整的端到端运行管道时,包括数据装载、模型推论和生成地理参考风险图时,框架仅用37分钟就用单一NVIDIA RTX A6000对整个研究区的大约36 978个结构进行了评估。 需要指出的是,报告这种不优化、相继的衡量方法是为了确定基线业绩底线;在真正的业务部署中,利用平行处理和较大的批量规模将大大减少这一执行时间。 该模型通过将像素预测汇总到结构边界,减轻了局部噪声并表现出了宝贵的保守偏差. 如实验结果所讨论,该框架自信地孤立了高风险结构,同时倾向于在模棱两可的中间情况下过度预测脆弱性,而不是预测不足。 在社区复原力规划方面,这种快速、大规模处理和故障保险保障的结合,确保了应急管理人员和决策者能够高效地在宽广的WUI环境中对资源进行分解,同时又不忽视非常脆弱的家园。

blocks.en: This study should be understood as establishing the scope and feasibility of a new multimodal assessment paradigm rather than exhausting the problem of structure-level wildfire vulnerability. The first boundary is data availability: street-view coverage is spatially uneven, historical captures may be temporally misaligned with pre-event satellite imagery, and occlusions from trees, walls, or parked vehicles can hide the facade conditions the model seeks to assess. The second boundary is label purity: although the paper transforms post-fire damage into a relative vulnerability proxy, the target variable still inherits noise from fire behavior, suppression dynamics, and neighborhood effects that cannot be fully disentangled from pre-fire structure susceptibility. A third limitation is signal granularity, particularly for adjacent low and moderate classes where semantic cues are subtle and class distinctions may be harder to observe from available imagery. Future research should therefore incorporate richer pre-fire inspection datasets, extend the framework with complementary modalities such as parcel records or fuels data, and test transferability across different regions, building typologies, and fire regimes. Additional work on uncertainty quantification and temporal updating would also strengthen the framework’s readiness for operational deployment.
blocks.zh: 这一研究应被理解为确定新的多模式评估模式的范围和可行性,而不是穷尽结构层面的野火脆弱性问题。 第一个边界是数据可用性:街景覆盖的空间不均匀,历史捕捉可能与事前卫星图像在时间上错配,从树木,墙壁或被停放的车辆上被遮住可以隐藏模型所要评估的外观条件. 第二个边界是标签纯度:虽然纸张将后起火的损坏转化为相对易发性代用,但目标变量仍然继承了火灾行为产生的噪音,压制动力学,以及无法从火灾前结构易发性中完全分解出来的邻里效应. 第三个限制是信号颗粒性,特别是对于相邻的中低等阶层,这些阶层的语义提示是微妙的,从现有图像来看,分类区分可能比较难。 因此,未来的研究应当包括更丰富的火前检查数据集,扩大框架,以补充模式,如包裹记录或燃料数据,并测试在不同区域之间的可转让性、建筑类型和火灾制度。 关于不确定性量化和时间更新的额外工作也将加强框架对行动部署的准备。

blocks.en: 6 Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 6 结论意见

blocks.en: This study presents a novel framework for structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment that overcomes the computational bottlenecks of community-scale multimodal fusion. Methodologically, it advances remote sensing analytics by (i) utilizing Vision-Language Models to compress high-resolution street-view imagery into semantically dense, lightweight text representations, (ii) leveraging a satellite-pretrained vision foundation model as the frozen backbone to extract macro-level spatial features from pre-event satellite imagery , and (iii) introducing a decoupled cross-attention decoder equipped with Rotary Position Embeddings to explicitly anchor numerous discrete and localized ground-level text features within a continuous overhead satellite basemap. This design replaces computationally prohibitive image-to-image fusion with semantically compressed, many-to-one alignment, reframing the multimodal problem around local coordinate grounding within a bounded satellite patch.
blocks.zh: 这项研究为结构一级的野火脆弱性评估提供了一个新框架,克服了社区规模多模式组合的计算瓶颈。 在方法上,它通过以下方式推进了遥感分析:(一) 利用Vision-Language Models将高分辨率街景图像压缩成密集而轻量级的文字表述;(二) 利用卫星预先训练的视觉基础模型作为冷冻的骨干,从事前卫星图像中提取宏观空间特征;(三) 引入了装有旋转位置嵌入物的脱钩跨意向分解器,将许多离散和局部的地平面文字特征明确地固定在连续的地平面卫星底图中。 这一设计用精密压缩、多对一的组合取代了计算上令人望而却步的图像到图像融合,并围绕局部坐标在有界的卫星地段内打地平地,重新说明多式联运问题。

blocks.en: Empirically, the ablation and diagnostic experiments confirm that explicit spatial alignment is critical for bridging the gap between ground-level semantics and overhead imagery. The study reveals that RoPE, through its multiplicative coordinate transformations, effectively preserves delicate semantic details while injecting relative spatial awareness, outperforming additive methods like Random Fourier Features in real-world scenarios. Evaluating the model at the building level further reveals a highly desirable conservative bias in the upper vulnerability tiers, minimizing the dangerous under-prediction of severe risk.
blocks.zh: 从经验来看,膨胀和诊断实验证实,明确的空间相通对于弥合地平面语义和地平面图像之间的差距至关重要。 研究显示,ROPE通过其多相坐标转换,在注入相对空间意识的同时,有效地保存了微妙的语义细节,在现实世界情景中比起"随机傅里叶地物"等效果好的添加剂方法. 在建筑物一级评价该模型进一步揭示出高度脆弱层非常可取的保守偏好,将严重风险的危险预测不足降到最低。

blocks.en: From a practical perspective, the framework delivers a highly scalable operational pipeline for pre-fire screening of individual structures across expansive wildland-urban interface communities. By sidestepping the massive computational overhead of pixel-to-pixel cross-view fusion, the system successfully processed approximately 1,000 structures per minute on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU without parallel processing. Because the model can infer risk from pre-event satellite imagery and routinely available street-view captures, it supports mitigation prioritization before a fire occurs rather than only explaining damage after the event. Emergency managers and local governments could use the outputs to identify clusters of high-risk parcels, target defensible-space outreach, prioritize inspections, and stage resilience investments, while utilities, insurers, and risk modelers could leverage the structure-level outputs to supplement portfolio screening and community risk stratification where field inspections are infeasible at scale.
blocks.zh: 从实际角度看,该框架为在广阔的野地-城市界面社区对单个结构进行火灾前筛选提供了一个高度可扩展的运行管道。 通过绕过像素对像素交叉视图聚变的巨大计算间接,系统在单NVIDIA RTX A6000 GPU上成功处理大约每分钟1000个结构,没有平行处理. 由于该模型可以推断出事前卫星图像和例行可得到的街景捕捉的风险,因此它支持在火灾发生前确定减灾的优先次序,而不仅仅是在事后解释损害。 应急管理人员和地方政府可以利用这些产出,确定高风险包裹组合、可防御空间目标外联、优先检查和启动复原力投资,而公用事业、保险商和风险建模商可以利用结构层面的产出,在无法进行大规模实地检查的情况下,补充组合筛选和社区风险分层。

blocks.en: To translate the framework into practice, implementation should proceed as a staged workflow rather than a one-time modeling exercise. Agencies or partners would first assemble current building footprints, recent pre-event satellite imagery, and the most recent available street-view or equivalent ground-level imagery for the target jurisdiction; next, the Vision-Language Model extraction and coordinate projection modules would generate spatially anchored semantic descriptions for each structure-facing capture. The multimodal model could then produce tile-level predictions that are aggregated to building footprints and ranked into actionable intervention tiers for inspection, mitigation, or portfolio review. Operational uptake would require coordination among fire agencies, local governments, utilities, insurers, and community resilience offices, with clear protocols for how model outputs trigger field verification, homeowner outreach, or mitigation subsidies. The most likely barriers are incomplete ground imagery, uneven data refresh cycles, and institutional hesitation around black-box predictions; these can be mitigated through periodic data updates, fallback use of alternate ground imagery sources, and targeted review of extreme-risk or uncertain cases. Framed this way, the model becomes part of a decision-support pipeline: screen broadly, validate strategically, intervene selectively, and update continuously as new imagery becomes available.
blocks.zh: 为了将框架转化为实际行动,执行工作应当作为分阶段的工作流程进行,而不是一次性的建模工作。 各机构或合作伙伴将首先收集目前的建筑足迹、最近的事前卫星图像,以及目标管辖区最新的街景或等同的地平面图像;其次,远景-语言模型提取和协调投影模块将产生空间定位的语义描述,说明每个结构成形的捕获。 然后,多式联运模型可以产生砖瓦级的预测,这些预测可归纳为足迹,并排入可采取行动的干预层次,用于检查、缓解或组合审查。 业务吸收将需要消防机构、地方政府、公用事业、保险商和社区复原力办公室之间的协调,并有明确的协议,说明示范产出如何触发实地核查、房主外联或缓解补贴。 最可能的障碍是:地面图像不完整,数据更新周期不均匀,以及围绕黑箱预测的体制犹豫;这些障碍可以通过定期更新数据、使用替代地面图像来源以及有针对性地审查极端风险或不确定情况来缓解。 通过这种方式,该模型成为决策支持程序的一部分:广泛屏幕、战略验证、有选择地干预,以及随着新图像的出现不断更新。

While the initial prompt instructs the model to evaluate 25 distinct characteristics, passing all variables directly into the text encoder introduces unnecessary semantic noise. To optimize the language embeddings for the downstream fusion decoder, the framework filters this raw output down to its most predictive components.

blocks.en: S1.3 Wildfire Risk Feature Dictionary and Selection
blocks.zh: S1.3 野火风险特征词典和选择

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 2.3 , a recursive feature elimination strategy utilizing XGBoost was applied to isolate the variables that most significantly impact building survival. Table S1 details the complete dictionary of 25 features evaluated by the VLM. The variables marked with a “Yes” in the final column represent the 16 optimally selected contributing features that were retained for the final multimodal integration, successfully removing 9 non-contributing or overly noisy attributes.
blocks.zh: 如第2.3节所讨论,采用了利用XGBoost的递归特征消除战略,以隔离对建筑物生存影响最大的变量。 表S1详细列出了由VLM评价的25个特征的完整词典. 最后一栏中标有“是”的变量代表了为最后多式联运一体化而保留的16个最佳选择的贡献特征,成功地去掉了9个不贡献或过于吵闹的属性。

blocks.en: After filtering the JSON dictionary to retain only these 16 critical contributing features, the structured data must be reformatted into a semantic structure that is easily digestible by the CLIP language encoder.
blocks.zh: 在过滤出JSON词典只保留这16个关键贡献特征后,结构化的数据必须被重编为语义结构,这种结构很容易被CLIP语言编码器所消化.

blocks.en: S1.4 Natural Language Conversion
blocks.zh: S1.4 自然语言转换

blocks.en: The final step of the data preparation pipeline is a rule-based structured-to-unstructured conversion. To maintain data density and prevent the CLIP encoder from wasting attention on irrelevant information, benign or absent risk states such as a feature evaluated as “false” are omitted entirely rather than explicitly described. The remaining confirmed vulnerabilities are concatenated into a cohesive, comma-separated descriptive caption.
blocks.zh: 数据准备管道的最后一步是基于规则的结构化到无结构化的转换. 为了保持数据密度并防止CLIP编码器浪费对不相干信息的注意力,诸如被评价为“虚假”的特征等无害或不存在的风险状态被完全省略,而不是明确描述。 其余经证实的脆弱性被压缩成一个连贯的、有逗号的描述性标题。
